name: CareerPoint Napa County Career Center
description: Free career services and job training referrals for Napa County residents
fullDescription: CareerPoint Napa is Napa County's career center, part of the Workforce Alliance of the North Bay. It provides free job search and career development services to all job seekers regardless of income, education, employment status, or background.
whatTheyOffer:
- One-on-one career guidance and coaching
- Resume and cover letter help
- Job search assistance and interview preparation
- Referrals to training, education, and certification programs
- Career readiness workshops
- Hiring events and job fairs
- Computers, internet, printers, and scanners for job searching
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the Napa County Center, Monday-Friday 8:30 am-4:30 pm
2. Or complete the online interest form and a Career Advisor will contact you
3. Meet with a Career Advisor
4. Access training referrals and job search services
address: 2751 Napa Valley Corporate Dr, Napa, CA 94558
keywords: Napa County, workforce, CareerPoint, Workforce Alliance of the North Bay, AJCC, America's Job Center, job training, career services, wine country
